全局 MCP & Skill
中文 | English
**Manage MCP servers and Skills in DeepSeek Harness: discover local capabilities, install from sever
al marketplaces, and inspect actual usage.** Open **全局 MCP & Skill** below Plugins in the sidebar.
## Features
| View | What it provides |
| **MCP · Registered** | Scan host MCP configurations, inspect connections, enable, disable, configu

re, check, or remove servers. Filter and group by source, with source-wide bulk actions. |
| **MCP ·
Market** | Search, categorize, bookmark, and install deduplicated entries from the official Registr

y, Smithery, Docker MCP, GitHub MCP, Awesome Remote, and Awesome List. |
| **Skill · Registered** |
Read `$DSH_HOME/skills`, `~/.agents/skills`, `~/.claude/skills`, and `~/.codex/skills`. Inspect desc

riptions, origins, files, and directories, with search, sorting, and an alphabet index. |
| **Skill
· Market** | Browse ClawHub, Anthropic official skills, SkillHub, and GitHub. Use a local index, cat

egories, source filters, popularity ranking, and installation. |
| **MCP · Calls** | Inspect tool re
quests, responses, outcomes, latency, and connection failures over the last hour, 24 hours, or 7 day

s. |
| **Skill · Calls** | Inspect tool loads and slash-command references, filter events, fold repe
ated references, and page through results. References count with their actual multiplicity; latency
averages only measured tool loads. |
Both Registered lists default to 20 entries and offer **20 / 50 / 100** per page. MCP and Skill shar
e one navigation row and preserve the selected view type when switching.
### Counters and ranking
- Stars and download counts can refresh. Opening or paging measures supported counters for the visib
le items, with a five-minute cache for successful measurements. Manual refresh bypasses that cache.
- Rate limits, network failures, or missing fields retain earlier values with a visible error and me

asurement time. Old values are not presented as a successful refresh.
- Skills default to popularity
order. Only SkillHub downloads and Stars receive a **30%** ranking weight; in the all-sources popul
arity view, SkillHub entries start at rank **21**. If fewer than 20 other-source entries match, Skil
lHub entries remain withheld from that view and can be accessed through the source filter. A SkillHu
b-only filter does not reserve those positions, and displayed counters retain their original values.
- Global popularity uses the local index plus measured updates. It does not claim that every market

place entry is refreshed simultaneously.
- The Calls rail includes only resources with actual events
**inside the selected time window**. Names, counts, and scope labels agree. Export covers the curre
nt filtered results within the host's retained records.

## Install and update
Requires **Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`** and DeepSeek Harness.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replace `<profile>` with your DSH profile name and the directory with your local checkout, then rest
art DSH. Update a checkout with `git pull` and a restart. Packages installed through npm can use the
panel's self-update action. Updating GitHub code does not publish an npm package.
**The host loads Skills when a session starts.** After adding or removing a Skill, restart DSH and u
se a new session. Discovery does not mean a running session has loaded it; Skills have no enable swi
new session. Discovery does not mean a running session has loaded it; Skills have no enable switch.
## Local index and network access
Once collected, a Skill index supports local search, categories, sorting, and paging. **Installation
still downloads files, and counter refresh still contacts providers.** Refreshing a page does not c
rawl the entire market. Use source management to collect the full index again when needed.
The index records received rows, source cursors, sample/full modes, and incomplete coverage. It is a
cache, not a live mirror. An October 2026 collection measured 214,747 rows, including 205,037 from
SkillHub; those are historical measurements, not today's marketplace totals.
GitHub authentication is optional. Detect an existing `gh` login or configure a Token in GitHub acce
ss settings for a larger allowance. GitHub's response determines the actual quota and reset time. So
urce failures show a Chinese explanation with expandable original diagnostics.
## Data and directories
Plugin data lives in `$DSH_HOME/overall-mcp/`, defaulting to `~/.dsh/overall-mcp/` when `DSH_HOME` i
ata lives in `$DSH_HOME/overall-mcp/`, defaulting to `~/.dsh/overall-mcp/` when `DSH_HOME` is unset.
| File or directory | Contents |

| `registry.json` | Registered servers, origins, and configuration. |
| `catalog-cache.json` | Cache

d MCP catalogs. |
| `skills-index.json` | Skill index, source cursors, and coverage notes. |
| `gith

ub-auth.json` | Locally saved GitHub credentials, never returned to the panel in plain text. |
| `ca
lls.jsonl` | Bounded call records; reference folding happens on read without rewriting event timesta

mps. |
| `ui-prefs.json` | View preferences such as the reference-folding window. |
| `events.ndjson

` | Operation and source-request diagnostics. |
| `skills-trash/` | Recovery directory for removed S

ation and source-request diagnostics. |
| `skills-trash/` | Recovery directory for removed Skills. |
The plugin reads existing host MCP configurations without rewriting those files. New Skills go into
`$DSH_HOME/skills/<name>/`, with the exact path shown after installation. Removing a Skill moves it
into the plugin's recovery directory.
